profile: Workspace release/bench profile; global counting allocator enabled. Validation and full consumption are timed; serialization only in explicitly named write benchmarks.
method: Committed M23 with final benchmark workload definitions overlaid. Exact binaries copied before timing. Final pairs use seven 300 ms samples in forward/reverse order; full suite uses seven 50 ms samples. No throughput or profiling runs overlap with each other or with builds/tests/differentials.
budget_difference: Baseline new-region allocation budgets are loose enough to measure M23. Final benchmark sources tighten them to M24 counts. Expressions, inputs, result checks, allocator and consumption are unchanged.
reproduce_baseline: Create a checkout/archive of e345b37; overlay crates/jx/benches from M24. Relax only new regions allocation budgets to baseline counts, then cargo bench -p jx --bench throughput --locked --no-run. Copy the executable Cargo reports. baseline-path.txt is local provenance, not a required path.

artifacts.after.csv, final-smoke.csv, checks.log,: Final full suite, allocation assertion smoke and verification.
artifacts.before-regions.csv, callback-regions.csv: Initial seven 100 ms samples: M23, parameter callbacks/reuse, then callback-pipeline fusion. These predate final metadata and fallback boundaries; not final gains.
artifacts.paired-*, reverse-*: Seven 300 ms samples before lazy fallback and single-operation callbacks; expose initial nested-sum/grouping regressions.
artifacts.structural-*: M23 versus outlined/lazy fallback, minimum two callback operations; first wider-constructor measurements.
artifacts.cse-*: No-reuse experiment versus reuse, both before lazy fallback. No-reuse prototype removed from production.
artifacts.simple-*: Minimum two versus one callback operation, after lazy fallback. Isolates single-operation call/frame savings.
artifacts.dispatch.json: Native common tree-dispatch prologues for M23, pre-lazy, lazy and final builds.
artifacts.profile-*: Five-second sampling profiles; qualitative hotspot attribution, not throughput claims.
artifacts.final-paired-*, final-reverse-*: Final shared-plan production code and tight budgets against committed M23; 62 selectors plus a matching repeated-lookup workload, both orders.
artifacts.pre-compact-*: Seven 300 ms pairs, full suite and checks before compiler slot-mask cleanup; unused source/reuse vectors add 2 allocations /104 B to dynamic scalar compilation. Earlier profile-after is qualitative.
artifacts.compact-*: Seven 300 ms pairs, full suite and checks with compiler slot-mask cleanup but boxed callback plans. Dynamic scalar compilation restored to M23 allocation count; dynamic export deep-clones body plan metadata.
artifacts.sharing-*: Isolated boxed versus shared immutable plans, 17 selectors in both orders, before tight dynamic-export allocation budget. Five export allocations removed; stored values and lexical frames are unchanged.

limitations: Allocator calls and requested bytes are measured, not live retention or process RSS. Latency distributions unmeasured.
No native compiler/JIT, instruction-set expansion, input index or frame cache is introduced.
Control fold/sort/group losses are recorded in final comparisons. No added scans/frames/storage found; residual code-layout/dispatch cause not isolated.
Static plan body argument metadata is compile-time-only. Ordinary value and context layouts are unchanged.
Compiled callback metadata adds setup/export cost to dynamic programs; sharing removes deep plan clones. Ordinary invocation borrows the shared body without refcount operations.
correctness_method: Final just all/build and all 21 differential suites pass. Independent differential subprocesses run four at a time, entirely before throughput/profiling measurements.

paired_final.scope: Final shared-plan code and tightened allocation assertions; exact workload definitions overlaid on committed M23.

profile_baseline: profile-before uses the initial M23 binary with the same nested-map fixture. Final after profile uses the retained shared-plan binary; compilation/setup is excluded from hotspot interpretation.
